title: São Paulo
summary: São Paulo dates its founding to 25 January 1554, when Jesuits on the Piratininga plateau inaugurated a college, the Casa de São Paulo. It stayed small, with about 300 residents by the end of the 16th century, and in the 17th century was a base for expeditions inland seeking slaves and mineral wealth. Coffee spurred mass immigration from the late 19th century, and it became a metropolis by 1950.

as_recorded.value: Founded in 1554 as a small settlement by Jesuit missionaries
